Go is installed at /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/go and reports go1.26.4 android/arm64.
Local butler binary is /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/tmp/butler-android-bin/butler, built from official itchio/butler source under /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/tmp/butler-src-1780609690.
The local binary reports head, no build date; push/status work despite the harmless android-arm64-head/LATEST 404 self-version check.
